tbl_description: One row per MOHT (Matsuda-Oozeki-Hu Trawl) micronekton net tow on a CalCOFI cruise, 2010-2012. Position, depth, volume filtered, and total density/abundance per tow. Full datetime_start_utc (Q03 RESOLVED) is joined in from the same workbook's 'Original' sheet by CruiseID+Tow -- see flds_redefine.csv and questions.csv Q03/Q06.
Species-resolved density/abundance per tow, pivoted long from the 90 named-species + 1 unidentified-fish wide columns in the source sheet.

Reference table of the 90 named species parsed from the source sheet's species column headers (the 'UnidentifiedFish' catch-all is excluded — it has no name). One row per species, resolved to a WoRMS AphiaID by calcofi4db::standardize_species(); build_dataset_taxon() crosswalks scientific_name into the global taxon table so obs.taxon_key is populated at release.
